Name: Muted Boosts
Author: Kayyteee
Description:
I wanted to make a little mod that changes the appearance of fertilizer, speed-gro and retaining soil to match my modded save. If you want a more town down look this mod might work for you. 

[u]Others mod needed: [/u]
-Content Patcher 
-SMAPI

Just place the folder '[CP] Muted Boosts' into your mod folder and thats it :D
